:::{#exm-cond-linearity}

#### Linearity, given the first flip

Continuing @exm-cond-expectation-general,
given $X = 1$, $Y$ is $1$ or $2$ with probability $1/2$ each,
so $\E{Y \mid X = 1} = 3/2$ and

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{Y^2 \mid X = 1} &= (1 + 4)/2 \\
&= 5/2.
\end{aligned}
$$

By @thm-cond-linearity with

$$
\begin{aligned}
a &= b \\
&= 1:
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\ba
\E{Y + Y^2 \mid X = 1}
&= \E{Y \mid X = 1} + \E{Y^2 \mid X = 1}
&& \text{(linearity of conditional expectation)} \\
&= \tfrac{3}{2} + \tfrac{5}{2}
&& \text{(substitute)} \\
&= 4
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

As a check, directly:

$$
\begin{aligned}
(1 + 1) \cd \tfrac{1}{2} + (2 + 4) \cd \tfrac{1}{2} &= 1 + 3 \\
&= 4.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
